transactions.text: Signed LB Joe Bachie from the practice squad to the active roster. Signed C Seth McLaughlin and RB Jabari Small to the practice squad. Placed G Mason Miller on the practice squad/injured list.

Signed OLs Devin Cochran and Mason Miller, WRs Malik Cunningham and Jackson Meeks, DE Ahmed Hassanein, TE Zach Horton, RB Jabari Small, DL Chris Smith and S Loren Strickland to reserve/futures contracts. Re-signed OL Michael Niese, RB Jacob Saylors and CB Nick Whiteside.
